mapper.select: SELECT t.user_card_transaction_id AS userCardTransactionId, t.res_member_store_name AS resMemberStoreName, t.res_member_store_type AS resMemberStoreType, t.res_used_amount AS resUsedAmount FROM user_card_transaction t JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = t.user_card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} -- AND uc.is_deactivate = FALSE AND t.res_used_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND t.res_cancel_yn = '0' AND t.res_account_currency = 'KRW'

SELECT t.user_card_transaction_id, t.user_card_id, t.partner_id, t.res_used_date, t.res_used_time, t.res_card_no, t.res_card_no1, COALESCE(c.card_name, t.res_card_name) AS res_card_name, t.res_member_store_name, t.res_used_amount, t.res_payment_type, t.res_installment_month, t.res_approval_no, t.res_payment_due_date, t.res_home_foreign_type, t.res_member_store_corp_no, t.res_member_store_type, t.res_member_store_tel_no, t.res_member_store_addr, t.res_member_store_no, t.res_cancel_yn, t.res_cancel_amount, t.res_vat, t.res_cash_back, t.res_krw_amt, t.comm_start_date, t.comm_end_date, t.res_account_currency, t.is_deleted, t.created_at, t.deleted_at, t.last_modified_at FROM user_card_transaction t JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = t.user_card_id JOIN card c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id AND c.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.res_used_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY t.res_used_date DESC, t.res_used_time DESC
